title: Kite with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- kite string -->
  <path d="M50 72 Q45 82 38 88 Q30 94 22 92" fill="none" stroke="#7ec8e3" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- kite body - diamond shape -->
  <polygon points="50 8, 88 45, 50 82, 12 45" fill="#ff6b6b" stroke="#ffaaaa" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- left panel shading -->
  <polygon points="50 8, 50 82, 12 45" fill="#e84a4a" stroke="none" opacity="0.5"/>
  <!-- cross spars -->
  <line x1="50" y1="8" x2="50" y2="82" stroke="#ffdd57" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="12" y1="45" x2="88" y2="45" stroke="#ffdd57" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- smiling face - eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="38" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="38" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <!-- eye highlights -->
  <circle cx="39.5" cy="36" r="1.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="63.5" cy="36" r="1.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="52" r="5" fill="#ff9ff3" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="52" r="5" fill="#ff9ff3" opacity="0.8"/>
  <!-- big smile -->
  <path d="M36 52 Q50 68 64 52" fill="none" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- smile fill -->
  <path d="M36 52 Q50 68 64 52 Q50 60 36 52 Z" fill="#ffe066" opacity="0.3"/>
  <!-- cute bow tails at bottom -->
  <path d="M50 82 Q42 90 40 96" fill="none" stroke="#ff9ff3" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 82 Q58 90 60 96" fill="none" stroke="#ff9ff3" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- top tip accent -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="8" r="3" fill="#ffdd57"/>
  <!-- side tips -->
  <circle cx="88" cy="45" r="3" fill="#ffdd57"/>
  <circle cx="12" cy="45" r="3" fill="#ffdd57"/>
</svg>
